functions.name: computer
functions.description: Control a computer's screen, mouse and keyboard. Choose an action; take a screenshot to see the screen. The display is 1280 by 800 pixels; coordinates are pixels from the top left corner.

coordinate.description: [x, y] in pixels: where to click, move to or scroll (and where a drag ends).

text.description: The text to type (type), the key or key combination such as ctrl+s (key, hold_key), or modifier keys held during a click or scroll.

start_coordinate.description: left_click_drag only: [x, y] where the drag starts.

scroll_amount.description: scroll only: how far to scroll, in scroll clicks.

region.description: zoom only: [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the region to capture at full resolution.
